thread.title: AMS joins list of Apple suppliers trimming outlooks - MarketWatch

author: Wallace Witkowski
title: AMS joins list of Apple suppliers trimming outlooks - MarketWatch
text:
AMS AG AMS, -9.69% cut its forecast late Wednesday, adding to a number of Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.82% suppliers cutting outlooks because of lower-than-expected sales. AMS said it sees fourth-quarter revenue of $480 million to $520 million, down from its forecast of $570 million to $610 million made in late October, because of "recent demand changes from a major consumer customer." Analysts surveyed by FactSet had estimated revenue of $617.6 million. Over the week, suppliers Lumentum Holdings Inc. LITE, -0.26% and Qorvo Inc. QRVO, -1.21% warned of lower-than-expected sales .
